title: finding(changeset): `object-form-option-icon-offer-withdrawn` says the options repeater offers exactly `SelectOptionSchema`'s authorable keys minus `visibleWhen` — `default` is authorable and not offered either
body:
Found while implementing #14327 (the recursive form ↔ Zod reconciliation walk). Filed unassigned and not fixed there — a text-accuracy defect in a merged changeset is not that card's scope.

## What the changeset says

`.changeset/object-form-option-icon-offer-withdrawn.md` (landed with #14326 for #13671) states:

> The repeater now offers `label`, `value`, `color` and `description` — exactly `SelectOptionSchema`'s authorable keys minus `visibleWhen`, which is a CEL predicate rather than a repeater text input.

## Measured

`SelectOptionSchema` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`) declares six keys, none tombstoned: `label`, `value`, `description`, `color`, `default`, `visibleWhen`. The repeater offers four. The set difference is `{ default, visibleWhen }`, not `{ visibleWhen }`. The widened #3786 gate's first run names it verbatim:

```
object.fields.options: accepted by the Zod but unauthorable in the form — offer it, or add a ledger entry: expected [ 'default', 'visibleWhen' ] to deeply equal []
```

`default` (`z.boolean().optional()`, "Is default option") is authorable at the publish door and is not offered by the quick-add row; the `object.fields.options` ledger row added by #14327 names both keys.

## Why it matters

The changeset body ships verbatim as `CHANGELOG.md` inside the published `@objectstack/spec` package — it is what an upgrading author or agent reads to learn what the object designer teaches. "Exactly … minus `visibleWhen`" tells that reader the row offers `default`, which it does not.

## Shape of the fix

A one-line text correction in the changeset while it is still unconsumed (the Version Packages PR regenerates from `.changeset/*.md`), or a CHANGELOG correction at the next version if it has already been folded. No accept/reject behaviour is involved; nothing in the form or the schema moves.

Refs: #14326 (the changeset) · #13671 (the withdrawal it describes) · #14327 (the gate widening that measured the set).
